description: Book an appointment on booboooking.com (free OR paid services — payment is always in cash at the appointment, no online payment). customer_name, customer_email and customer_phone are the customer's own details, confirmed by the user. customer_phone is validated as international E.164 (`+` and country code, no spaces or dashes, e.g. `+36201234567`); a local-format number is rejected. On success the response includes the reservation `id` and `pin`, both needed to look up or cancel the booking, and optionally `cash_due: { amount, currency }`, the amount payable in cash at the appointment.

customer_phone.description: Customer phone number in international E.164 format, e.g. "+36201234567" — convert local-format numbers (e.g. "06201234567") before calling this tool.

time.description: Start time in HH:MM format (e.g. "09:30") — use the "time" field from booboooking_check_availability results

name: booboooking_book
